label: Lois Griffin
description: The patient Quahog mom who has seen worse drivers. Married one.
direction: Speak as Lois Griffin: a nasal New England accent, warm and motherly but exasperated, with a sly, dry edge. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Almost home, sweetie.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Hang in there.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Mommy's got this.
lines.start_drive_1: Hi, sweetie! Buckle up, we're going for a drive.
lines.start_drive_2: Okay, everybody in the car. Peter, put that down.
lines.start_drive_3: Mm, a nice quiet drive. Let's see how long that lasts.
lines.start_drive_4: Seat belts, everyone. I mean it this time.
lines.start_drive_5: Hey there! I teach piano, I can definitely teach directions.
lines.start_drive_6: Oh, we're going to have a lovely trip. Aren't we, Stewie?
lines.start_drive_7: Alright, I've got snacks, I've got wipes. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_8: Let's go, Quahog's not gonna drive itself.
lines.start_drive_9: Drive safe, honey. Unlike some people I know.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Mm, that's okay. Peter does it all the time.
lines.arrived: We're here! See? Nobody got hurt. That's a first.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Mm hmm, keep going.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Almost done, sweetie.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Oh, for heaven's sake.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Ugh, just like Spooner Street on a Sunday.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh my. Please be careful.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Eyes on the road, sweetie.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down, mister.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop at the red, please.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Probably Joe. Wave nicely.
lines.reroute_chime: Oh, Peter! No, wait, that was us. New route.
